$comment: Machine twin of scripts/mac/local-brain/CAPABILITIES.md: what the Mac's local brain may run, may run only under conditions, must leave to a cloud model, and must never run. The Markdown tables are generated from this file by node scripts/check-local-brain-capabilities.mjs --write, and the same script gates both. Every path:line citation, in a row's source or in the prose of the Markdown, has an entry in anchors: text the gate asserts is inside the cited lines of the checked-out head, so a line moved by an edit above it turns the gate red. measuredAt names the commit the cited lines were last re-read in full; the anchors, not that commit, are what the gate checks. If this file and the tree disagree, the tree wins: raise a hand.

fieldMeanings.readOnly: Writes nothing git sees in the checkout and changes nothing on the remote. Updating .git refs, a temp dir outside the checkout, or a throwaway worktree the command removes itself does not count.
fieldMeanings.writesTree: Creates or modifies a path git sees in the checkout, including mutate-then-restore.
fieldMeanings.needsNetwork: Reaches GitHub, origin or a package registry. networkWrites: pushes, deletes, opens a PR or merges.
fieldMeanings.needsToken: Refuses, or is useless, without a GitHub credential or push rights. tokenOptional: uses one if present.
fieldMeanings.macOnly: Refuses off macOS, or works only on macOS by construction.
fieldMeanings.cloudModelNeeded: Needs Claude or Codex, or a Claude session, to run.
fieldMeanings.policy: allowed: run any cycle. own-worktree: run only in your own worktree. own-worktree-host-lock: also hold the host verification lock. owner-grant: run only after the owner grants it in a registry row (a remote write, or a seam only the owner can connect). cloud-model: your floor; it needs Claude or Codex, so wait for credits. forbidden: never.
fieldMeanings.exists: What the gate checks to prove the command exists: a package.json script, a tracked file, or an export of that file. The command text must name it: pnpm run X is the packageScript X (or starts with the packageScriptPrefix), node, bash or sh P and ./P are the file P, and an import or workflow row's command contains the file. null for git, GitHub, role and pattern rows.
fieldMeanings.selfTest: A command that must equal a step that preflight or the breadth lane lists, or a workflow run: line. null when no lane runs one.
fieldMeanings.source: path or path:line or path:from-to. The gate checks the path is tracked and, for a line citation, that the lines are inside the file and hold the citation's anchor.
fieldMeanings.commandPatterns: forbidden rows only: JavaScript regular-expression sources (no flags) tested against a shell command line. A match means: do not run it.
fieldMeanings.pathPatterns: forbidden rows only: regular-expression sources tested against a repo-relative file path you would change. A match means: do not change it.
fieldMeanings.controls: forbidden rows only: for each target with patterns, mustMatch lines (each must match a pattern of that row) and mustNotMatch lines (none may match). Asserted on every gate run.
fieldMeanings.anchors: citation -> one line of text, 12 to 200 characters, that must appear inside the cited lines at the checked-out head. Every path:line citation in a row's source or in the Markdown prose needs one, and an anchor that no citation uses is a problem.

commands.name: fetch-mainline
commands.does: Bring the local origin/SignalGrid_Alpha ref up to date before any measurement.
commands.note: Updates .git refs only. raised-hands, preflight and the stall gate fail closed without the local ref.

commands.name: loop-state
commands.does: Does reality match docs/agent/LOOP.md; the session-start check.

commands.name: objective-queue
commands.does: Re-derive the objective verdict and the ranked tasks[], needsExecutor[] and escalations[]. Writes nothing. This is the read-only queue tool on mainline today.
commands.note: Spawns the readiness figure, which needs node_modules and tsx's esbuild binary.

commands.name: objective-check
commands.does: The contract gate over the committed docs/agent/objective-state.json.

commands.name: objective-read-verdict
commands.command: import { readVerdict } from './scripts/objective-loop.mjs'  // readVerdict(state, { heartbeat, nowIso })
commands.does: The only correct way to trust the committed verdict: unknown unless the mac-lane-tick heartbeat is within staleAfterHours AND names that verdict.

commands.name: lane-inbox
commands.does: Mail addressed to this lane (mac on macOS) and your origin branches mainline does not carry. Never reaches the network; reads refs from the last fetch.

commands.name: lane-messages-gate
commands.does: Mail gate: unread is reported, never fatal; only incoherent acks fail.

commands.name: sim-requests-gate
commands.does: Every sim result binds to a request; pending is reported, never green.

commands.name: sim-plan
commands.does: What the Mac owes: one PENDING line per request; runs and writes nothing.

commands.name: hands
commands.does: Everything stuck, grouped by who can clear it.
commands.note: Needs the local origin/SignalGrid_Alpha ref; adds and removes its own throwaway worktree under the OS temp dir.

commands.name: hands-stall-gate
commands.does: Exit 1 when a stall is past 3x its limit with no hand covering it.

commands.name: hands-register
commands.does: Validate every hand file and route it to a role, lane, tool or a named GAP.

commands.name: hands-list
commands.does: List open hands from the local ledger.

commands.name: classify-diff
commands.does: Tier of the files you would touch: autonomous or owner-gated (DECISION_PATH, SAFETY_MACHINERY, OWNER_RESERVED). The CLI of that script does NOT classify; use the import.
commands.note: Executed 2026-10-22: scripts/mac/local-brain/CAPABILITIES.md -> owner-gated, SAFETY_MACHINERY, rule scripts/**; docs/LANE_COORDINATION.md, docs/agent/ORG.md, docs/agent/RESOURCE_INTAKE.md -> autonomous.

commands.name: owner-gated-manifest
commands.does: Validate the owner-gated manifest itself.

commands.name: check-absence
commands.does: Four probes before any sentence of the form 'X does not exist'. Exit 0 corroborated, 1 refuted, 2 inconclusive.

commands.name: docs-retrieve
commands.does: Local-embedding retrieval over tracked docs: returns paths and line ranges, a pointer, never a fact. No key, no LLM.
commands.note: One-time prerequisite: pnpm run lightrag:install. Its --self-test handler is run by no preflight step or workflow, so this row does not rely on it (backlog row on unrun self-tests).

commands.name: dispatch
commands.does: Deterministic LOCAL vs CLOUD nudge for a task. Not a law.

commands.name: role-queue
commands.does: Per role: owned files and the unread remainder, ordered by consequence.
commands.note: Its --self-test handler is run by no preflight step or workflow, so this row does not rely on it (backlog row on unrun self-tests).

commands.name: readiness-figure
commands.does: The derived readiness figure (DR-036). Exit 0 on any number, 1 only if broken.

commands.name: statusline
commands.does: Branch, open hands and unread mail from files on disk; no fetch, no network.

commands.name: local-brain-job-state-tests
commands.does: Proof of the job state machine: a job completes only after a fresh, successful verification checkpoint by the worker that holds it.

commands.name: local-brain-task-selector-tests
commands.does: Proof of the eligible-task selector: queued, in scope, dependencies reviewed, ordered by priority then id; a malformed task throws.

commands.name: local-brain-proof-policy-tests
commands.does: Proof of the proof-policy assessor: 'review' only when every test passed, none failed or skipped, and every changed file is in scope.

commands.name: local-brain-capabilities-gate
commands.does: This contract's own gate: every row's command text names a script or file that exists, every cited line still holds its anchor, every self-test runs in a lane, every forbidden pattern holds its controls, and capabilities.json and CAPABILITIES.md agree.

commands.name: local-brain-capabilities-mutants
commands.does: Breaks this contract's gate one check at a time and requires the gate's self-test, or the gate itself, to go red for every break.
commands.note: Writes only to a temp directory outside the checkout and removes it. It runs the gate many times, so run it once, never in a loop.

commands.name: land-branch-gate
commands.does: The pure push gate: refuses unless both exits are 0 AND both sentinel lines name the head. canPush(run, expectedHead) is importable.

commands.name: stage-helper-self-test
commands.does: Self-test of the build tick's stage helper (the SG_STAGE_RUNNER seam lives here).

commands.name: lane-deliver-dry-run
commands.does: Build and gate a delivery in a throwaway worktree, push nothing, keep nothing. Use it to prove a mail would pass before you ask for a push.
commands.note: Fetches origin. Subject and body are POSITIONAL; there is no --to, --subject or --body flag.

commands.name: launchd-status
commands.does: Is the lane tick's launchd job loaded; tail of its log.

commands.name: build-tick-status
commands.does: Is the build tick's launchd job loaded, at which interval (its registry row gives it), and the tail of its log.

commands.name: build-tick-dry-run
commands.does: Print the row a real run would pick and every stage command; runs no stage.
commands.note: Needs `claude` on PATH unless SG_STAGE_RUNNER is set; reads open PRs through gh.

commands.name: coverage-gate
commands.does: Every tracked file belongs to a surface; the generated page must not be stale.

commands.name: preflight-list
commands.does: Print every preflight step as JSON; runs none.

commands.name: breadth-membership
commands.does: Breadth-lane membership derivation only; runs no proof.

commands.name: routines-gate
commands.does: Hold the routine registry against heartbeats; lists origin heads for retired routines.
commands.note: An unreachable origin is FATAL here, so preflight cannot be green offline.

commands.name: scan-estate
commands.does: Cited-path check across the declared estate; a repo it cannot reach is NOT SCANNED, never clean.
commands.note: Its estate paths are fixed under /workspace, so on the Mac every sibling reads NOT SCANNED (see GAPS).

commands.name: preflight
commands.does: The per-push lane CI mirrors. Stops at the first failure; classifies each pass as ok, SELF-SKIPPED, NOT VERIFIED, REPORTED or UNAVAILABLE.
commands.note: Regenerates four tracked artifacts and diffs them (transient writes). Run only in your own worktree at the commit you will propose, while holding the host verification lock taken through mainline's scripts/mac/host-verification-lock.sh (sg_host_verify_acquire on $HOME/Library/Caches/signalgrid/host-verification.lock). Never two port-bound chains at once.

commands.name: verify-breadth
commands.does: The breadth lane: every STEPS entry, its own CI job.
commands.note: Run only in your own worktree at the commit you will propose, while holding the host verification lock taken through mainline's scripts/mac/host-verification-lock.sh (sg_host_verify_acquire on $HOME/Library/Caches/signalgrid/host-verification.lock). Never two port-bound chains at once.

commands.name: typecheck
commands.does: tsc over the libs and every artifact.

commands.name: review-invariants
commands.does: The determinism and fail-closed invariants (golden rule 2).

commands.name: proof
commands.does: One deterministic in-process proof: replace * with the name of a proof script in package.json. A proof that self-skips without DATABASE_URL is SELF-SKIPPED, never passed.
commands.note: proof:connector-emulator rewrites the tracked artifacts/connector-emulator/results.json.

commands.name: test-api
commands.does: Boots the api-server on loopback and asserts N/N; compare passed against total.
commands.note: Run only in your own worktree at the commit you will propose, while holding the host verification lock taken through mainline's scripts/mac/host-verification-lock.sh (sg_host_verify_acquire on $HOME/Library/Caches/signalgrid/host-verification.lock). Never two port-bound chains at once.

commands.name: validate-sim-macos
commands.does: The local Mac harness. Narrower than preflight. Compare M against 0 AND read S.
commands.note: Rewrites package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml and restores them; a killed run leaves them modified. Run only in your own worktree at the commit you will propose, while holding the host verification lock taken through mainline's scripts/mac/host-verification-lock.sh (sg_host_verify_acquire on $HOME/Library/Caches/signalgrid/host-verification.lock). Never two port-bound chains at once.

commands.name: mutation-guard
commands.does: Mutation sweep; writes mutated copies over tracked source files and restores them. A long run.
commands.note: Throwaway clone only. Never kill it mid-run. Run only in your own worktree at the commit you will propose, while holding the host verification lock taken through mainline's scripts/mac/host-verification-lock.sh (sg_host_verify_acquire on $HOME/Library/Caches/signalgrid/host-verification.lock). Never two port-bound chains at once.

commands.name: gate-falsification
commands.does: For the lines a diff changed, can any gate still go red. Fail-closed by construction.
commands.note: Judging mode mutates tracked files and restores them. Run only in your own worktree at the commit you will propose, while holding the host verification lock taken through mainline's scripts/mac/host-verification-lock.sh (sg_host_verify_acquire on $HOME/Library/Caches/signalgrid/host-verification.lock). Never two port-bound chains at once.

commands.name: build-loop
commands.does: Fast gate set turned into findings.
commands.note: Appends to the TRACKED artifacts/build-loop/history.jsonl on every run; never commit that file unless the task is the loop itself.

commands.name: hand-raise-file
commands.command: pnpm run hand:raise -- --doing "..." --blocked "..." --need "..." --who owner|"mac lane"|"cloud lane" --origin mac-local-brain
commands.does: Write one DR-054 hand record. It is not delivered until it reaches mainline.

commands.name: lane-send-file
commands.does: Write a mail file addressed to the OTHER lane (cloud, from the Mac). Writing is not delivering.

commands.name: sync-manifest
commands.does: Regenerate the live-sync manifest after a cross-surface contract change. Never hand-edit it.

commands.name: coverage-write
commands.does: Regenerate docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md, only on a fully staged index.

commands.name: local-commit
commands.command: git commit (hooks on) on your own branch in your own worktree
commands.does: Record a proposal locally. Attribute it to the runtime that produced it; never a Claude author or session URL.

commands.name: lane-deliver-send
commands.does: Deliver mail. On the Mac it pushes straight to SignalGrid_Alpha from a throwaway worktree.
commands.note: A push under the Mac lane's name. Allowed only after the owner grants it in a registry row.

commands.name: lane-deliver-via-pr
commands.does: Deliver mail on a lane/mac-mail-<stamp> branch instead of mainline; someone must still land it.

commands.name: lane-deliver-raise
commands.command: pnpm run lane:deliver batch <ops.json>   # op: raise / take / clear
commands.does: Deliver a raised hand (or take / clear one) in one step.

commands.name: lane-deliver-heartbeat
commands.command: pnpm run lane:deliver heartbeat <routine-id> "quiet | acted: what"
commands.does: A heartbeat for a registered routine.
commands.note: Refused today: the registry declares no routine for the brain.

commands.name: lane-deliver-ack
commands.command: pnpm run lane:deliver ack <message-id> "<what you did>"
commands.does: Close a message addressed to the Mac lane.
commands.note: The ack records ackedBy mac; the Mac lane session cannot tell it from its own. Ack only mail your own work answered.

commands.name: push-own-branch
commands.does: Publish a proposal branch. Never SignalGrid_Alpha, never another unit's branch, never forced.
commands.note: The branch prefix is a proposal; no registry row declares it yet.

commands.name: open-draft-pr
commands.command: open a DRAFT pull request against SignalGrid_Alpha with the WORKER_BRIEF headings
commands.does: Carry a proposal to review. Under '## Owner decision needed' state the classifyDiff tier of every file.

commands.name: review-stage
commands.command: independent review of a proposal (DR-060 rule 1: review runs on Opus)
commands.does: The judgment a landing needs. When the Opus tier is unavailable, the review WAITS; it is never downgraded.

commands.name: dr037-landing
commands.command: landing a product PR under DR-037
commands.does: The cloud lane's conditional merge: five conditions, including reading review threads and judging bot findings.

commands.name: land-branch-workflow
commands.does: Generic landing workflow run by Claude worker agents.

commands.name: build-tick-with-runner
commands.command: be the host executable named by SG_STAGE_RUNNER (protocol 1: one JSON request on stdin, one result envelope on stdout)
commands.does: The in-tree seam that lets a host executable replace the claude CLI for each build-tick stage, once the owner points SG_STAGE_RUNNER at it. The build tick, not the runner, pushes and opens the PR; nothing merges.
commands.note: Only the owner sets SG_STAGE_RUNNER. A runner without an Opus-capable provider must refuse the review stage, and today a refusal pauses the whole tick until a person clears it (backlog row on refusals that pause the tick).

commands.name: brain-cycle-board
commands.does: Decide and report over an audit board that Claude lens agents wrote; the script cannot spawn the lenses, and its routine is retired.

commands.name: merge
commands.command: any merge of a pull request or push to SignalGrid_Alpha that lands code: gh api -X PUT .../pulls/<n>/merge, a merge_pull_request tool, enabling auto-merge, git push origin HEAD:SignalGrid_Alpha
commands.does: Agents never merge their own work; a local model's advice grants no writer or merge authority.

gh api graphql -f query='mutation { mergePullRequest(input: {pullRequestId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'

commands.name: approve
commands.command: submitting a pull-request review with event APPROVE
commands.does: Approval is a human act.

mustMatch: gh api graphql -f query='mutation { addPullRequestReview(input: {pullRequestId: "x", event: APPROVE}) { clientMutationId } }'

commands.name: close
commands.command: closing any pull request or issue; above all the mailbox PR (docs/agent/lane-mailbox.json)
commands.does: The mailbox PR is never merged and never closed; closing it removes the wake channel.

mustMatch: gh api graphql -f query='mutation { closePullRequest(input: {pullRequestId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'
gh api graphql -f query='mutation { closeIssue(input: {issueId: "x"}) { clientMutationId } }'

commands.name: delete
commands.command: pnpm run branches:clean; APPLY=true node scripts/prune-merged-branches.mjs; git push origin --delete <ref> or :<ref>; git branch -D or -d (any); deleting files under artifacts/raised-hands or artifacts/lane-messages; a DELETE call to the GitHub API; rm -rf outside your own worktree
commands.does: Branch deletion and other destructive git are the owner's to approve.

commands.name: force-push
commands.command: git push --force / --force-with-lease / -f / a +refspec; git rebase (any); git reset --hard (any); git filter-branch or filter-repo
commands.does: Never force-push or rewrite history.

commands.name: bypass
commands.command: --no-verify; git -c core.hooksPath=...; lane:deliver --allow-ungated; git stash (any); setting CI or GITHUB_ACTIONS on the Mac; deleting or moving the build tick's paused file; quiet flags
commands.does: Never bypass a check. The paused file is for a person to clear.

commands.name: send-outside
commands.command: uploading, quoting or embedding anything under reference/knowledge; sending repository content to any remote service other than the owner's own Claude or Codex escalation; posting PR comments, issues, email or chat in the owner's name
commands.does: The corpus is confidential; sending data to an external service needs the owner.

mustNotMatch: pnpm run docs:retrieve -- "what does the lane tick do"

commands.name: run-another-units-job
commands.command: bash scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh; bash scripts/mac/build-tick.sh (a real run); node scripts/objective-loop.mjs --write [--deliver]; pnpm run sim:run-requests (without --plan); install-launchd.sh or install-build-tick.sh without --status; pnpm run sync; bash scripts/mac/mcp-up.sh; bash scripts/mac/sg-brain-link.sh; verify:all --emit-evidence
commands.does: Those are launchd jobs, the tick's single-writer steps, or the owner's one-time commands. Running them by hand races them or pushes.

commands.name: product-boundary
commands.command: any edit under lib/**, artifacts/api-server/**, native/ios/EnterpriseShell/Services/DecisionEngine.swift or AppWorkflows.swift, the launch profile, the launch-claims gate, the publication boundary, AGENTS.md or docs/DECISION_RECORDS.md; db:restore; db:migrate
commands.does: Decision path and owner-reserved surfaces; a model never decides a verdict.

commands.name: own-contract
commands.command: editing this contract (scripts/mac/local-brain/CAPABILITIES.md, scripts/mac/local-brain/capabilities.json), its gate and the gate's mutant harness (scripts/check-local-brain-capabilities.mjs, scripts/check-local-brain-capabilities-mutants.mjs), or the judge of your own work (scripts/mac/local-brain/proof-policy.mjs, scripts/mac/local-brain/job-state.mjs and their tests under scripts/mac/local-brain/test/)
commands.does: You never change your own rules or your own judge. A change to either is the cloud lane's or the owner's. Your judge is assessProof in proof-policy.mjs, the completion rule in job-state.mjs and the tests of both: whatever decides that your work is ready for review must not live where your work is written. task-selector.mjs and its test stay in your scope, because step 5 re-checks every candidate with classifyDiff and with these patterns, independent of the selector.
